method.method_draft: 先从图像中观察江郎山主体为高大、近乎垂直的丹霞石柱和陡崖，崖壁大面积裸露，只有山脚或较缓处有绿色植被。再结合题干询问“根据景观照片，许多地方不长植物的原因”，将裸露区域与陡峭坡面联系起来：坡度越陡，降雨形成的地表径流速度越快，冲刷作用越强，风化物和细土难以停留并发育成土壤，因此植物缺乏生长基础。答案归纳为：坡度陡、流水冲刷强、土壤难以形成。

raw_record.original_question:
2010年8月，“中国丹霞”被列入《世界遗产名录》。下图为中国丹霞之浙江江郎山著名景观图。

<image1>

根据景观照片，许多地方不长植物的原因是什么？
raw_record.answer: The slope is steep, running water erosion is strong, and soil is difficult to form
raw_record.final_cot: In the image, it can be seen that the main body of Jianglang Mountain is tall, nearly vertical Danxia stone pillars and steep cliffs; large areas of the cliff walls are in a state of exposed rock, and green vegetation is mainly distributed at the foot of the mountain or in places with gentler slopes. From this it can be inferred that many exposed parts have very steep slopes; after rainfall, the speed of surface runoff is fast, the erosive action of running water is strong, and weathered materials and fine soil are difficult to remain on the slope surface and develop into soil; lacking soil, the foundation for plant growth, many places therefore do not grow plants.
